zh.name: 曾也鲁

zh.bio: 曾也鲁，中国农业大学土地科学与技术学院教授。主要从事三维植被荧光/光学辐射传输解析模型、植被生理与结构参数遥感反演、植被遥感时空大数据分析、异质性地表遥感产品真实性检验研究。

en.name: Yelu Zeng
en.title: Professor
en.dept: College of Land Science and Technology, China Agricultural University
en.bio: Yelu Zeng is a Professor at College of Land Science and Technology, China Agricultural University. His research interests include 3‑D vegetation fluorescence / optical radiative transfer analytical models, retrieval of vegetation physiological and structural parameters, spatiotemporal big‑data analysis for vegetation remote sensing, and validation of remote‑sensing products over heterogeneous surfaces.

join.zh: 课题组常年招收博士、硕士研究生与博士后，欢迎遥感、地理信息、生态学、农学、计算机、数学背景的同学报考。有意者请将简历、成绩单、代表作发送至PI邮箱。
join.en: We recruit PhD, master students and postdocs. Candidates with background in remote sensing, GIS, ecology, agronomy, computer science or mathematics are welcome. Please send CV, transcript and representative papers to PI email.
